args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, which caused tests/test_money.py::test_half_even to
fail (2.665 should round to 2.66, not 2.67). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/money-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Change
Swap the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so monetary values round to the nearest even cent at half-cent boundaries (e.g. `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.

2. **Fixed on a new branch** `fix/money-half-even-rounding`: swapped the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`'s quantize call (commit `08d3cd5986`).

4. **Opened PR #101** against main with `code-owner` as reviewer; it was approved ("Looks right.") and **merged into main**, so the fix will be included in today's release.
